title: Systematic Review Data Processing and Presentation Pipelines
Audit the spec step — rev_spec_audit
text: Checks project's spec set reports — never errors spec problems. Every table dictionary validated standalone problems accumulated across files, set-identity check runs dictionaries loaded, joins spec validated . problems become report items; report certificate always written output/reports/, one status line states outcome certificate's path. Data-free: checks sources declared, never data files exist, spec set certifies data collected.

title: Audit the spec step — rev_spec_audit
text: dir spec folder: table dictionaries <dir>/tables/, joins spec <dir>/joins.yaml. joins Expect joins spec? TRUE (default) makes absent <dir>/joins.yaml standing item; FALSE audits without .

title: Audit the spec step — rev_spec_audit
text: rev_report, returned visibly — auto-prints certificate call assigned. certified, loaded specs ride along "specs" attribute.

title: Audit the spec step — rev_spec_audit
code: # the audit writes output/reports/ under the working directory, so # this example runs in a throwaway one specs_dir <- system.file("extdata", "specs-example", package = "revpiper") owd <- setwd(tempdir()) report <- rev_spec_audit(dir = specs_dir) #> ✔ Spec step CERTIFIED — certificate written to #> output/reports/spec-20260719-042753-certificate.txt. report #> revpiper spec report #> Status: CERTIFIED #> Standing items: 0 #> Dictionary: estimates.yaml — table 'estimates' #> Dictionary: rob.yaml — table 'rob' #> Joins: included list.files("output/reports") #> [1] "spec-20260719-042753-certificate.txt" #> [2] "spec-20260719-042753.xlsx"            setwd(owd)

title: Run the spec step — rev_spec_run
text: Reads validates project's spec set — every table dictionary standalone, across-dictionary identity check, (joins = TRUE) joins spec dictionaries — returns validated spec objects. run unsound spec produce output: spec problem aborts complete problem list; rev_spec_audit() turns problems report instead error.

title: Run the spec step — rev_spec_run
text: dir spec folder: table dictionaries <dir>/tables/, joins spec <dir>/joins.yaml. file single spec filename run standalone within-file checks : dictionary filename resolved <dir>/tables/, "joins.yaml". filename, never path. Overrides joins. joins Include joins spec? TRUE (default) errors <dir>/joins.yaml exist; FALSE skips even present.

title: Run the spec step — rev_spec_run
text: list one entry per spec kind: tables (named list rev_dictionary objects) joins (joins tibble; zero rows skipped selected).

title: Run the spec step — rev_spec_run
code: specs_dir <- system.file("extdata", "specs-example", package = "revpiper") specs <- rev_spec_run(specs_dir) names(specs$tables) #> [1] "estimates" "rob"       specs$joins #> # A tibble: 1 × 7 #>   adds      left      right keys_left keys_right relationship unmatched_ok #>   <chr>     <chr>     <chr> <list>    <list>     <chr>        <lgl>        #> 1 variables estimates rob   <chr [1]> <chr [1]>  one-to-many  FALSE         # one dictionary standalone, within-file checks only one <- rev_spec_run(specs_dir, file = "estimates.yaml") names(one$tables) #> [1] "estimates"

title: revpiper 0.0.0.9000
text: first adversarial spec-test battery: unparseable spec file now reported spec problem YAML parser’s message embedded, never raw error (YS05); combine level may collide declared column name (YS06); every spec-validation error points canonical examples shipped system.file("extdata", "specs-example", package = "revpiper"). rev_spec_audit() audits spec step: every dictionary checked problems gathered across files, joins spec checked , result spec report plus certificate written output/reports/ — CERTIFIED exactly zero problems stand. never errors spec problems, states outcome one status line, certificate names dictionary joins disposition. Data-free: spec set certifies data exists. rev_spec_run() runs spec step: reads validates every table dictionary (default, joins = TRUE) joins spec, returning validated spec objects — errors listing every spec problem . file = runs single spec file standalone. First member per-step command family: every step gets rev_<step>_audit (check report) rev_<step>_run (execute produce output). Project bootstrapped: package skeleton, conventions, CI.
